items.text: Leave Kc-III (check-out; leave the key as instructed).
Taxi to the terminal (first train not verified).
If sent by option A, collect the suitcases at JAL ABC, T3 3F (24 h), with the receipt and passport. Free terminal bus T3 → T1 → T2 if needed.
ANA check-in for TK8364 (counter opening time not verified). Tax-free goods: keep receipts and packaging sealed until departure.
TK8364 (operated by ANA) Haneda → Istanbul, arr. 16:45. Layover 3 h 45 min. TK1029 Istanbul 20:30 → Sofia 20:50.
